Summary
: This is an English study of the Aitareya Brahmana—a crucial Vedic text from the Rigveda divided into eight sections, emphasizing the responsibilities of priests known as Hotris and elaborating on Soma sacrifices and various rituals. The Aitareya Brahmana itself blends rituals with myths, legends, and the roles of deities while the present study offers a historical and cultural insight into the societal structures, economic conditions, and geographical knowledge reflected within the text.
Other titles: Aitareyabrāhmaṇa (ऐतरेयब्राह्मण) Aitareya-brāhmaṇa (ऐतरेय-ब्राह्मण), Aitareyabrahmana.
